02-14.title: The first Yeezy Boost dropped
02-14.text: The Yeezy Boost 750 was the first shoe of the adidas partnership to reach retail. A grey suede high-top with a strap, sold in tiny numbers through a confirmed-reservation app. It set the template for how every Yeezy after it would be released.
02-14._source_hint: adidas Yeezy Boost 750 first release February 2015
02-14.post_text: The Yeezy Boost 750 was the first adidas Yeezy to reach retail. Grey suede, a strap, sold in tiny numbers through a reservation app — the template every Yeezy after it copied.

02-17.title: Michael Jordan was born
02-17.text: Brooklyn, 1963. Every Jordan silhouette that followed traces back to a single endorsement deal a rookie almost turned down because he wanted adidas.
02-17.post_text: Brooklyn, 1963. Every Jordan that followed traces back to an endorsement deal a rookie almost turned down, because he wanted adidas.

02-22.title: The Pigeon Dunk turned a shoe release into news
02-22.text: Jeff Staple's Pigeon Dunk released at Reed Space on Orchard Street with 150 pairs. People camped through the snow, fights broke out, and buyers left in police escorts. The New York Post ran it on the front page. It is the day sneaker releases stopped being a subculture story.
02-22._source_hint: Nike SB Dunk Low Pigeon Reed Space 2005 New York Post riot
02-22.post_text: 150 pairs at Reed Space. Fights broke out, buyers left in police escorts, and the New York Post ran it on the front page. The day a sneaker release became news.

02-25.title: The letter that sold a million shoes
02-25.text: The NBA wrote to Nike objecting to Jordan's shoes under the uniformity rule. Nike's response was to build an ad campaign around the objection. The shoe in the letter was not actually the Jordan 1 — but the story attached to it permanently, and Nike never corrected the record.
02-25._source_hint: NBA letter Nike Air Jordan banned 1985 uniformity rule
02-25._contest_note: The letter's date is cited variously as Feb 25 1985 and later. The Air Ship vs Jordan 1 distinction is well documented and is the interesting part; the date is the weak link. Do not approve until a source pins it.
02-25.post_text: The NBA wrote to Nike objecting to Jordan's shoes. Nike built an ad campaign around the objection — and never corrected the part where the shoe in the letter wasn't the Jordan 1.

03-26.title: Air Max Day — the day you could see the air
03-26.text: Tinker Hatfield cut a window into the midsole so the cushioning could be seen. Nike's own engineers argued against it. The Air Max 1 released and every visible-air shoe since descends from that one decision.
03-26._source_hint: Air Max Day March 26 1987 Air Max 1 Tinker Hatfield visible air
03-26.post_text: Tinker Hatfield cut a window into the midsole so the cushioning could be seen. Nike's own engineers argued against it. Every visible-air shoe since descends from that.

06-11.title: The Flu Game
06-11.text: Game 5 of the Finals, Jordan visibly unable to stand between plays, 38 points. The black-and-red 12s he wore that night are the reason that colorway is still called the Flu Game and not by its actual name.
06-11._source_hint: Flu Game June 11 1997 Jordan 12 NBA Finals Game 5
06-11.post_text: Game 5 of the Finals. Jordan could barely stand between plays and put up 38. The black-and-red 12s are still called the Flu Game, not by their actual name.

08-23.title: Kobe Bryant was born
08-23.text: Kobe pushed his signature line toward low-cut soccer-inspired silhouettes when every basketball shoe was a high-top. Performance basketball footwear never went back.
08-23._sensitivity_note: Birthday, not the death date — but the association is immediate and the audience reaction is unpredictable. Flagged tragedy_adjacent so the loader records it and never proposes it. Rail 4: silence is always acceptable. Included so a future session does not 'discover' it and add it unflagged.
08-23.post_text: Kobe pushed his line toward low-cut soccer-inspired silhouettes when every basketball shoe was a high-top. Performance basketball footwear never went back.

10-18.title: The shoe that actually got banned
10-18.text: Jordan wore the black-and-red Nike Air Ship in preseason — not the Jordan 1, which did not exist yet. The Air Ship is the shoe the league objected to, and it spent thirty-five years as a footnote to a story about a different shoe.
10-18._source_hint: Nike Air Ship black red Jordan preseason 1984 banned
10-18._contest_note: The substance is well documented; the exact preseason date is not. If verification cannot pin a day, delete rather than approximate.
10-18.post_text: The shoe the league objected to was the Nike Air Ship, not the Jordan 1, which did not exist yet. It spent thirty-five years as a footnote to a story about a different shoe.

12-03.title: The defection
12-03.text: Kanye left Nike for adidas over royalties and creative control. Nike had the biggest name in sneaker culture and let him walk. adidas built its entire decade on the shoes that followed.
12-03._source_hint: Kanye West adidas deal announced December 2013 leaves Nike royalties
12-03._contest_note: The announcement date and the signing date differ across sources. Pin one and record which.
12-03.post_text: Kanye left Nike for adidas over royalties and creative control. Nike had the biggest name in sneaker culture and let him walk. adidas built its entire decade on what followed.

06-23.title: A player earned serial 1 of the Varsity Red
06-23.text: On 23 June 2026 a player completed the Nike x Jordan 4 SB set in CYPHER and was awarded serial 1 of the Jordan 4 Retro SB 'Varsity Red', a GRAIL card capped at 10000. The set requires two cards, the SB Navy and the SB Pine Green, both of which can be pulled from packs. The reward has been claimed 2 times; the second went to the house a month later.
06-23.post_text: Serial 1 of 10000. A player finished the Nike x Jordan 4 SB set and the GRAIL was theirs. Two cards in, one out — that is the whole trade.
